files.problem: Presentation accessibility: eliminate hue-only meanings and give spoken/cued state labelled captions.
files.architecture: Semantic palette IIFE feeding CSS/canvas/shaders; redundant glyphs; caption ring and settings; optional cue glyphs.
files.work_items: Five slices: palette validation, all colour consumers, redundant cues, spotter/announcer captions/settings, optional cue visualiser.
files.implementation: PARTLY SHIPPED; palette and caption APIs exist. LSP palette references only appearance options and itself; complete canvas/shader adoption not established. Caption consumers include announcer, spotter, announce-banner and appearance settings.
files.measurement_provenance: 22-semantics/9-colour-only inventory and contrast, shader, layout budgets are dated 2026-10-04 evidence, not measurements repeated here.
files.relationships: Extends deferred accessibility brainstorm item 13 and player accessibility slice 5; preserves separate physics contracts.

files.problem: Rank missing product capabilities across six research angles.
files.architecture: Tier 1 six individual plans, Tier 2 deeper racing, Tier 3 risky larger bets.
files.work_items: Suggested share cards then overlay then reel; PWA/accessibility independent; localisation serialised against large UI work.
files.implementation: OPEN ranking; partly or fully shipped child status labels require per-plan scope checking.
files.measurement_provenance: Research provenance explicitly mixed: repo inventory with two corrected errors; several search snippets and background support claims; no new market measurements.
files.relationships: Coordinates six October 4 plans; links older mechanics/AI/strategy work and later fair-play plan. Deferred serverless leaderboard depends on determinism evidence.

files.problem: Twenty-second pose ring cannot retain a whole race highlight story or export video.
files.architecture: Read-only event journal taps RaceFacts through RaceRadio; scored capped clip vault; pure scorer/planner; reel player; feature-detected WebCodecs plus muxer or MediaRecorder fallback.
files.work_items: Three slices: in-game reel, encoding/audio/vendor/backend resize, sharing polish; manual device gates.
files.implementation: OPEN; no matching reel/vault/encoder files found in static JS filename inventory. Historical unused journal stub was deleted per status.
files.measurement_provenance: Historical pose sizes, memory estimates, support research and licensing claims are source assertions; encoder throughput, OBS/device behavior and music redistribution remain unverified.
files.relationships: Extends broadcast-feel results-highlight slice C, reuses camera kit and replay discontinuity contract; constrained by memory plan and share-card delivery precedent.

files.problem: English text is scattered through DOM, JS sinks and template concatenations.
files.architecture: Gettext-style inline English fallback, lazy hashed JSON, ICU-lite plurals and Intl helpers; DOM applier; pseudo locale; lint and migrated-surface guard.
files.work_items: Ten slices: foundation/picker/cache, lint, pseudo matrix, menus, HUD/results, Garage, Career/Data, captions, voice fallback, reviewed locale waves.
files.implementation: PARTLY SHIPPED: I18n APIs and DOM applier exist; locale manifest contains only English with two keys. LSP consumers establish DOM applier; no full screen migration or picker claim.
files.measurement_provenance: Historical counts (422 JS files, 427 concatenations, etc.) and language-market ranking are dated, heuristic provenance; no fresh full inventory.
files.relationships: Uses UI-MAP screen inventory, accessibility settings seam and radio template/voice-latency research. RTL and multilingual Kokoro deferred.

files.problem: Installed app lacks direct doors and external calendar reminders.
files.architecture: Manifest shortcuts and allowlisted deep-link consumer; cached schedule countdown; proposed UTC RFC5545 builder, optional static CI feed and install capability evaluations.
files.work_items: Four slices: shortcuts, countdown/sessions, client-side calendar, optional feed or launch/share handling.
files.implementation: PARTLY SHIPPED: manifest has five shortcuts including controller; DeepLink stages existing title buttons and retries while gates block title. Schedule countdown has visibility/disconnect cleanup. Calendar export not established.
files.measurement_provenance: Historical feed response, TTL/rate/terms and calendar-client UID/VALARM behavior remain dated external assertions; no network or client import performed.
files.relationships: Reuses Data Hub schedule/cache and ghost-file conventions; distinguishes real calendar from in-game season; optional feed depends on deployment staging and attribution.

files.problem: Text shares lack portable result images and compact staging links.
files.architecture: Pure serialisable card model and layout ops; shared PNG painter/font/QR/delivery layer; proposed short card-link envelope.
files.work_items: Four slices: daily/shared renderer, race/season/career, ghost chart/staging, preview/sizes/a11y.
files.implementation: Status says SHIPPED; static files and ShareCard rendering support infrastructure. LSP only identifies DailyChallenge as external ShareCard consumer; all five planned card integrations not substantiated. Actual module home is share directory, diverging from proposed UI home.
files.measurement_provenance: Historical budgets and canvas/API compatibility are plan evidence; no image rendering/device sharing performed.
files.relationships: Builds on player-accessibility text share envelopes, designer PNG precedent, Photo Studio and GhostShare; ghost samples deliberately remain outside QR card links.

files.problem: Creators need transparent graphics composited over gameplay from a separate OBS page.
files.architecture: Transport-blind pure feed schema and DOM painter; proposed 4Hz publisher, same-browser BroadcastChannel fallback and passive WebRTC/Nostr bridge.
files.work_items: Four slices: demo/schema/painter, same-browser publisher, passive peer transport, polish/docs.
files.implementation: Status says SHIPPED but static page loads feed/render/broadcast/TV graphics only. Non-demo boot paints waiting frame and returns; demo uses a 250ms interval. No overlay publisher/bridge files in inventory. Thus shipped demo infrastructure is narrower than complete live OBS goal.
files.measurement_provenance: OBS profile separation and WebRTC support were explicitly unproven; 3% CPU target is a proposed acceptance criterion, not a measurement.
files.relationships: Separate surface from broadcast camera plan; passive PhonePad-style side-channel proposal must not occupy netplay grid seats.

files.problem: Read-only 13-reviewer audit at 64dd7a8 found lifecycle/input/per-frame defects.
files.architecture: Subsystem batches each paired with targeted unit/VM pin and verification plan; first four prioritised, performance batch later, product decisions isolated.
files.work_items: Assigned prefix covers persistence/Garage batch 1 and lazy-boot batch 2 through partial row 2.6; remainder belongs to group04.
files.implementation: Status says SHIPPED via next-day fix-all plan; source explicitly says rows not reverified 2026-10-26. This map makes no per-row fix correctness claim.
files.measurement_provenance: Historical verified/repro labels distinguish coordinator source reread from Node/VM reproductions. Fuzz query counts and clean-subsystem conclusions are inherited audit claims, not rerun.
files.relationships: Subsequent fix-all plan is implementation handoff/superseding execution register; BUGS and defect ledger were dedupe inputs. Historical scratch reproducer references are preserved in JSON only.
